pages.text: The Kennestroyer Pickaxe is the ultimate mining tool, crafted from Netherite, Diamond Blocks, Obsidian, and the finest Diamond Workhand Improved Pickaxes. It combines all mining modes into a single tool with Vein Mining built-in.

pages.title: Mode Progression (Right-click to cycle)
pages.text:
$(bold)Disabled$(): No area mining
$(bold)Range 3 Flat$(): 3x3x1 area (single layer)
$(bold)Range 3 Cubic$(): 3x3x3 cubic area
$(bold)Range 5 Flat$(): 5x5x1 area (single layer)
$(bold)Range 5 Cubic$(): 5x5x5 cubic area

pages.title: Vein Mining
pages.text: When breaking an ore block, all connected blocks of the same ore type are automatically mined in a chain reaction, up to a maximum of 128 blocks. Works regardless of sneak state.

pages.title: Controls
pages.text:
$(bold)Left-click$(): Area mine + vein mining (when not sneaking)
$(bold)Shift + Left-click$(): Single block mining
$(bold)Right-click$(): Cycle through 5 modes

pages.title: Stats
pages.text:
Durability: 50,000
Mining Speed: 12.0
Attack Damage: +4
